items.statement: The source supports a lower I endpoint for the Pb-framework-related scalar-relativistic electronic interband gap, not necessarily for the fundamental gap or a proven optical onset.
items.expected: Conclude from validated, physically assigned framework results and separately report fundamental behavior. Do not award numerical/physical success from a guessed band or a well-described bounded failure; coverage limits must narrow claims.

items.statement: Any SOC estimate based on reduced model cells is an approximate trend correction and must be distinguished from a direct parent-cell SOC calculation.
items.expected: Keep no-SOC primary energies separate from optional direct-parent SOC and reduced-model estimates. Orbital projections establish character, not optical allowedness; that requires matrix-element or explicit symmetry/selection-rule evidence. State finite-k coverage and assignment ambiguity; no extra optical or SOC calculation is mandatory.
